# Amadeus QQ
简体中文 · Detailed configuration · Issues
QQ conversations with persistent DSH Sessions and explicit Scene permissions.
Target package: **`@fg-lab/amadeus-qq@1.2.1`**. Tested runtime baseline: official DSH Desktop **0.2.
1-rc.3**. MIT licensed.
## Release status
**1.2.1 is published:** GitHub Release · npm. Install the pinned version and verify the release chec
ksum. Later main changes do not change this immutable archive. See publishing policy.
## What you can do
- Connect an existing local NapCat instance to authorized groups and private chats, each with a pers

istent DSH Session in your Workspace.
- Continue a current conversation using read, wait, mark-read
and guarded sends; deduplicate delivery attempts and preserve Session history across ordinary config

uration edits.
- Handle supported text, mentions, replies and media through capability-specific chec

ks. Provider-dependent features remain conditional.
- Choose Observe, Safe Chat, Enhanced or Autonom
ous Social presets; trusted administrator private chats may use Owner Agent. Global denials and QQ p

latform permissions always apply.
- Manage account/profile operations and optional QQ Space capabili
ties on their separate account page. Availability depends on the actual provider and configured gran

ts.
- Pause NapCat listening for handoff to another application. QQ owns current conversations; opti
onal Life owns long-term wake scheduling.
Example: authorize a test group in Observe, inspect inbound status, then select Safe Chat when ready
to allow replies. Use the Web Console to inspect effective permissions instead of assuming that a p
reset grants every tool.
NapCat is not bundled: this plugin does not install, log in to or host NapCat. An unconfigured insta
llation sends nothing. Dangerous tools are not enabled by default. Memory, Life, State and Persona a
re optional; QQ does not grant access to their private data merely by receiving a message.
## Install and configure
Install the prebuilt `.tgz` with the official DSH plugin manager into your selected Profile. No loca
l source build is required. Follow installation instructions; do not copy configuration into a runni
equired. Follow installation instructions; do not copy configuration into a running Profile by hand.
Connect NapCat, choose a Workspace, set the Owner QQ number and authorize individual Scenes. Start w
at, choose a Workspace, set the Owner QQ number and authorize individual Scenes. Start with Observe.
The other Amadeus plugins are optional. Install only the integrations you need.
## Interface
This is a recorded interface screenshot, not evidence that every real platform capability passed the
current release gate. See the detailed reference and verification reports for limitations.
## Upgrade and recovery
Back up user data before upgrading. Code, persistent user data and recovery backups are separate. Di
sable stops functionality; uninstall is intended to retain external data. Restoring old code alone d
oes not reverse a database migration.
